race.comment: TINY PRANCER (8) was returning from a spell last time out when he made a long sweeping run to score at this circuit and distance. Interesting to see what unfolds from this wide draw but he will be fitter and has plenty of upside. Primary contender. BETTOR ELEMENTS (7) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when fourth at this circuit and distance. The driver has some work to do from this starting position but he is racing well. Last-start placegetter COOLABAH BILL (3) draws to be competitive again while MICKS CRUZA (2) is better placed so look for an improved result.
